value: LEGACY-BLANKET PARK LABEL CENSUS: regnorm screen of all 156 live parked/capped attempts carrying REGISTER_ONLY or SCHEDULE that PK's screen (claim.park-law-age-revisit-census.20260831.v1) did NOT cover, excluding TUs owned by concurrent lanes. THE POPULATION PK MISSED, AND WHY IT MATTERS: PK screened 26 AUTHORED REGISTER_ONLY parks. It did not touch the 143-record legacy family imported 2026-08-29T23:25:17Z from the old parked-cap blob (attributes.provenance 'terminal import of the legacy parked cap list'), every one of which carries the SAME machine-applied string 'REGISTER_ONLY/SCHEDULE (allocator or scheduler residual)'. That blanket label was never measured per function, and it is the single largest and lowest-confidence label population in the corpus. METHOD (reproducible, ~45 seconds of compute for the screen): parse memory_graph/records/attempts/**.json off disk (642 files, all with ids); drop any id named by another record's `supersedes` (483 live); keep outcome in {parked,capped} with REGISTER_ONLY or SCHEDULE in residual_class (191); reconstruct and exclude PK's set as the AUTHORED, pre-regnorm-law (2026-08-31T17:13:14Z) REGISTER_ONLY parks (24 recovered, vs PK's stated 26 - the 2-record gap is PK's own supersessions of GetAnimAngXYZVal/WPitchMat3/ProcessCritter, which now post-date the law; note the census record NAMES only 7 of its 26, so exact reconstruction is impossible and this criterion is the best available proxy); exclude functions/TUs claimed by the DC/LP/OC/PB/RS lanes; resolve unit from attributes.scope or build/GUNE5D/report.json; then `regnorm <unit> <fn> --map` on each. RESULT, 156 screened: 32 STALE-SOLVED (regnorm EXACT and fndiff confirms 0 real diff lines - park is moot, integrator should DELETE per parked-record hygiene); 1 LABEL CONFIRMED (fn_800DBE98, and only because its record had already been re-derived by hand); 103 STRUCTURAL-PRESENT; 20 COUNT-MISMATCH (unpaired instruction streams - the label was structurally impossible). CALIBRATED HIT RATE, the headline: the blanket label was the complete and honest residual class in 1 of 156 screened parks, i.e. 0.6%. PK measured authored REGISTER_ONLY labels right 'less than half the time'; machine-applied blanket labels are effectively never right, and the difference is that an authored label at least records a measurement. STRUCTURAL-ROW CLASSIFICATION over the 100 regnorm-parseable STRUCTURAL-PRESENT functions (1338 rows): 793 CFG-BRANCH-TARGET, 207 OPCODE-DIFFERS, 130 DISPLACEMENT-FRAME ((r1)-based, i.e. STACK_LAYOUT not register noise), 72 IMMEDIATE, 54 RELOC-SYMBOL (hand-off class for the RS lane), 42 OTHER, 40 CFG-BRANCH-SENSE, 5 DISPLACEMENT-OBJECT. The dominant hidden class is CONTROL FLOW, not allocation: 15 functions have residuals that are ENTIRELY branch-class (ControllerMessageBox, CritterAnimate, CritterMoveSetup, LoadItems, LoadWorldData, LoadWorldDone, MBNewPsysDescrip, PlaceItem, ProcessCritterList, StartWorldLoad, WorldDynCollide, fn_8004DB3C, init_player_change, pbDrawVerts, setWorldParms) - if/else vs goto shape, source-reachable, and mislabelled as allocator residue for two days. SEMANTIC-BUG SCREEN, executed as specified and NEGATIVE: only 5 DISPLACEMENT-OBJECT rows exist corpus-wide (do_mapscreen x2, kill_player x2, ResolveWorldData x1). All five were read against target bytes in the ALIGNED fnasm --diff view. NONE is a semantic bug: kill_player's rows are a regnorm pairing artifact (see the companion law record - both sides genuinely read lfs f0,2360(r31)); do_mapscreen and ResolveWorldData are cursor-base differences where the target pre-advances the pointer (do_mapscreen's target uses `lwzu r0,96(r24)` at +0x198, so it accesses 0(r24) where we access 96(r24) - the recorded lwzu-idiom class, source-reachable, NOT a wrong field). So the col_pos/effectpos precedent did not repeat here; the honest calibrated yield of this lane is a corrected corpus and a correctly-typed queue, not a bug harvest. STALE-SOLVED DELETION LIST (32 park record ids, all fndiff-verified at 0 real): attempt.parked.{allocmem32, atreeinitsub, audioang, audioplayereatsfx, critterlinenodecolsub, critterlookforcriticalmove, dmgfxadd, g3dupdatepadstatus, initanim, initlighting, mbnewfont, missilecollideenemy, pointlinedist2d, fn_800920e0, adjust_radius_8002b2d4, closest_enemy, dbgtextinit, fn_800511d0, fn_800b27c4, fn_800c031c, fn_800c1004, fn_800d967c, fn_800da6a4, gendir_8004fbc8, getsincos, joyreadpad, move_logic00, move_logic02, move_logic04, move_logic30, sndvoiceupdateall, vsprintf}.20260829.v1. Several are exact only via sanctioned WebFrank pins (joyReadPad, fn_800511D0, fn_800B27C4, InitLighting, fn_800D967C, fn_800DA6A4, getSinCos) - still exact, still moot as parks, and their source is FROZEN so no lane should reopen them. HIGH-VALUE RE-TYPED QUEUE for the next matching session, all with tiny measured residuals and 0 unpaired: FindClosestWaypoint (2 rows, pure 4-byte frame-slot delta 20 vs 24 - STACK_LAYOUT, slot-order law applies); MBDrawBlits (2 rows, lfs-vs-lfd - an f32/f64 constant TYPE difference, semantics-adjacent); fn_80051164 and sndFxInitVoices (2 and 6 rows, one repeated form: target `add rD,rB,rA` + `stw rS,DISP(rD)` vs our `addi r0,rA,DISP` + `stwx` - indexed-store vs base+displacement, the base+i*stride induction-form lever); fn_800D87FC (1 row, slwi vs rlwinm); scroll_credits and fn_80054E78 (constant-vs-copy plus a ghost reloc). TOOLING GAP FOUND: regnorm cannot resolve 5 symbols that fndiff resolves by stripping a trailing _<ADDR> suffix (setupNewPMode_800CDCE4, adjust_radius_8002B2D4, dtor_800DB21C, dtor_800DBB94, gendir_8004FBC8); they were screened with fndiff instead, yielding 2 more stale-solved and 3 more structural (both dtors carry an identical 'frame delta -8, our frame is BIGGER' hint - a paired inline-frame candidate). STANDING RULE EARNED: a park record whose label was written by a bulk importer rather than a measurement carries NO evidence at all and must be re-measured before it is allowed to veto anything; treat provenance 'terminal import' as equivalent to an empty record.
